Title: Action required: Support for Azure Monitor for SAP solutions (classic) resources will end by 31 March 2023.

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor for SAP Solutions (classic) is retiring. Support for Azure Monitor for SAP solutions (classic) resources will end by 31 March 2023.  

A new version of Azure Monitor for SAP Solutions (version 2.0) is now available in public preview. Azure Monitor for SAP solution (version 2.0) has feature parity with Azure Monitor for SAP Solutions (classic) and similar pricing model. Customers can collect and visualize end- to- end SAP technical monitoring telemetry in one place in Azure portal. We recommend the current Azure Monitor for SAP Solutions (classic) customers migrate to this new version as soon as possible.  

Actions recommended  

To avoid or mitigate possible disruptions to workflow, migrate to the new Azure Monitor for SAP solutions (version 2.0) before 31 March 2023. 

Review the migration scripts  for guidance as you migrate to SAP Solutions (version 2.0). 

Learn more 

Read our documentation and watch video in SAP on Azure YouTube channel.   

To get started, head over to Microsoft Azure portal and create your first resource.  

Share your thoughts and feedback with us in our community page.
